<function name="GetViewEntity" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the entity the player is using to see from (such as the player itself, the camera, or another entity).

	<note>This function will not return the currently spectated entity. See <page>Player:GetObserverTarget</page>.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="Entity">The entity the player is using to see from</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Will print what entity the first player uses to look through.</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetViewEntity() )</code>
	<output>Player [1][ExamplePlayer]</output>

</example>
